# Report 7 tables (generated by results/exp7/report7.py)

Variants, all d=3 adaptive, --stale-prob 0.3, data/d3_wide, h48/l4, fp32, batch 512, 60000 steps, seeds 0, 1, 2; only the fingerprint channels differ. Baseline = the existing adaptive-stale models (single fingerprint; results reused from results/exp6). B = multiscale (long, short = last 200 shots, short − long). C = B + 8 pair-covariance channels. Ensemble = mean of the 3 seeds' logits > 0 (fixed). Live: each model's own causal buffer; frozen: every channel from the nominal test set's fingerprint shots. Update every 200 shots. Streams pooled over stream seeds 0,1,2,3,4. McNemar exact, two-sided; p in 0.001–0.05 = weak evidence; no multiple-testing correction. The best WindowDEM is picked per phase after the fact.

## Decision rule (fixed in advance, computed here)

A variant passes if its ensemble beats the baseline ensemble at onset or after on bursts or bursts_big with p < 0.001, and is not worse than the baseline on later or drift steps in any regime (bursts, bursts_big, hot_qubit, telegraph) at p < 0.001. Live ensembles, pooled streams.

| variant | verdict | wins (onset/after, bursts/bursts_big, p < 0.001) | losses (later/drift, any regime, p < 0.001) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B multiscale | **FAILS** | bursts onset -0.0171 (p=3e-112); bursts after -0.0014 (p=8e-09); bursts_big onset -0.0175 (p=4e-67); bursts_big after -0.0030 (p=3e-26) | hot_qubit later +0.0002 (p=0.0005) |
| C multiscale+pairs | **FAILS** | bursts onset -0.0180 (p=2e-110); bursts after -0.0013 (p=5e-07); bursts_big onset -0.0046 (p=0.0001); bursts_big after -0.0024 (p=2e-14) | bursts_big drift +0.0050 (p=8e-21); bursts_big later +0.0082 (p=2e-43) |
